name: feature.cms.nodes
description: CMS feature node pack (write verbs C6) — workflow nodes over the `ctx.features.cms` surface shipped by the CMS feature. Reads: `get-page` (published page resolved for a target locale, exact → language-family → base) and `list-pages`. Generative: `translate-section` (sparse per-locale overlay via the run-scoped ctx.callAI). Governed writes: `update-section-draft` (DRAFT-only section patch, sanitized like an editor save) and `submit-page` (the SAME approval-gate composition as the editor submit — a node can draft and submit but NEVER publish). Reads are role:action (outputs recorded; replay/fork read the recorded result). The three WRITERS are role:side-effect (ADR 0668 D5): `update-section-draft` and `submit-page` mutate the pages store and are replay-SERVED; `translate-section` also writes and is additionally NON-DETERMINISTIC (it calls the model), so the generator holds it back from the served set as an ai-invocation-log and it re-executes on replay by design — RFC 0041 §B divergence injection depends on that, and the ADR 0326 invocation log is its discharge. Overlays are sanitized on persist.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: CMS Get Page (localized)
nodes.description: Fetch a published CMS page resolved for a target locale via ctx.features.cms.getPage. Inputs: { orgId, slug, locale? }. Output: { page, locale } — sections carry resolved `data` (exact → language-family → base per RFC 0103 §C); no `localizations` leaked. Published-only; null page when absent.

nodes.label: CMS List Pages
nodes.description: Lists an org's published CMS pages (pageId, slug, title, status) via ctx.features.cms.listPages. Inputs: { orgId }. Output: { pages }. Published-only; titles/slugs, not section bodies.

nodes.label: CMS Translate Section
nodes.description: Draft a sparse per-locale overlay for a section's base data via the run-scoped provider (ctx.callAI), structure-preserving JSON-in/JSON-out. Inputs: { data, targetLocale, provider?, model?, maxTokens? }. Output: { overlay, targetLocale } — a draft the editor reviews before saving; the page PATCH write path sanitizes it (anti-XSS / open-redirect). Invalid/empty model output FAILS TYPED (error code invalid_model_output) after ONE bounded error-fed repair attempt (ADR 0592 §7) — never success-with-empty; empty INPUT data returns an empty overlay (nothing to translate).

nodes.label: CMS Get Draft Page (raw)
nodes.description: A DRAFT/in-review page's RAW sections (base data + which overlay locales exist) via ctx.features.cms.getDraftPage (ADR 0204 C6) — the edit-then-submit read. Inputs: { orgId, pageId }. Output: { page } (null when absent). A tenant-scoped run reads like an org member; anonymous delivery stays published-only.

nodes.label: CMS Update Section (draft)
nodes.description: Patch a DRAFT page's section — its base data or one per-locale overlay — via ctx.features.cms.updateSectionDraft (ADR 0204 C6). Inputs: { orgId, pageId, sectionId, data, locale? }. Output: { updated, locale? }. A REFUSAL is a node FAILURE, not a success with `updated:false` — the error code is the reason (`not_found`, `section_not_found`, or `empty` when every key was dropped by the closed-world sanitizer), so a chain that continues past this node has genuinely written. Draft-only (409 otherwise); the surface sanitizes through the same overlay cleaner as an editor save.

nodes.label: CMS Submit Page (for review)
nodes.description: Submit a DRAFT page for editorial review via ctx.features.cms.submitPage (ADR 0204 C6) — the SAME approval-gate composition as the editor's submit: an ApprovalsInbox row is queued UNCONDITIONALLY (ADR 0593 C1 — under both toggle states; the toggle gates whether a direct publish is refused, not whether the review row exists); a node can draft and submit but NEVER publish. Inputs: { orgId, pageId }. Output: { submitted, status }. A REFUSAL is a node FAILURE with `not_found` as the error code — a green step here means an approval row really exists.
